study: Causal style-factor controls and fixed factor/neural blends
timing: Specified during fixed neural fitting before any new financial account results; motivated by old-portfolio attribution and established momentum/volatility literature
history: Same repeatedly inspected2022-2025 development period; no confirmation claim
definitions: momentum63_risk=eligible percentile of(price[t]/price[t-63]-1)/annualized20-sessionvol; momentum252_21_risk=percentile of(price[t-21]/price[t-252]-1)/annualized60-sessionvol(min40); volfloor5%; liquid_consensus=equal average of both scores and logADV percentile; missing trailing history neutral0.5; current eligibility unchanged
checkpoint: rank only, fixed before financial results; same50:50 family blend and all predefined seed groups; no selector search in this arm
count: 180 hybrid accounts(3styles*2nonzeroNNweights*2allocations*5groups*3costregimes)+18pure-factor controls(3styles*2allocations*3costregimes); seed-free controls reported once, not duplicated into artificial seed ensembles
risk_execution: Inherited20-session basket-volatility target20%, continuous QQQ cap75 constrained by unused gross budget/QQQvol, prior-close sizing and regular-close weekly execution; unchanged fees/borrow/liquidity assumptions
goals: Report whether any hybrid has SR>1.5 across all5predefined ensembles; separately report pure-factor performance and each group's incremental SR relative to its matching pure factor. A style-dominated or pure-factor result is not evidence that neural training improved.
stop: Exactly198additionalaccounts, no further style/weight/parameter expansion after outcomes; no extra training, seed filtering, retrospective winner tickers,2026market returns, live trading or prospective changes
limits: These papers motivate controls; our specific features, holding horizon and hedged portfolios are adaptations, not replications of published factor results. Same spent history and search disclosure remain necessary.
